Broken Fantasies

AYLA & Jake Beck

For your GRAMMY® consideration

Best Alternative Music Performance

Listen on Spotify Listen on Apple Music

Click the glass. Break a heart, break a crown.

AYLA's debut single. A voice kept close, a band that builds around it, and a song that gives people chills.

It is the hush of the opening lines, the band building underneath, and the last line that stays with you after the song ends. That is the moment that gives people chills. The vocal sits intimate and unguarded against rock production.

Bass, electric guitar, piano and drums are all played by Jake Beck, who also produced and recorded the track. AYLA and Jake Beck wrote Broken Fantasies together: a relationship told as a story, every line something to keep, erase or replay.
